meta.title: perf: Optimize _getAvailableSlots function and related operations
meta.body_summary: Implement memoization, caching, and reduced dayjs.tz operations to optimize slot calculations in _getAvailableSlots, and add a benchmark script (no benchmark results provided).

perf_labels.notes: Devin added memoization and a benchmark script without measurable evidence; no maintainer engagement, auto-closed after ~9.9 days.

core_change_summary.description: Added memoization to parseBookingLimit and parseDurationLimit, Map-based caching in slotsMappedToDate and withinBoundsSlotsMappedToDate, reduced dayjs.tz calls in isOutOfBounds and slots, and introduced a benchmark script with a shell runner.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Benchmark script and its shell runner were added but no benchmark output or numeric claim was included.
